text:
max: FYI security advisory: audit found ~120 service accounts with overly broad roles (compute.admin / storage.admin) created during last-year migrations. We need to trim scopes and enforce least-privilege. No evidence of exfiltration, but this is high priority.

iam-bot: scheduled-iam-scan: scan_id=iam-2026-03-22-7, findings=120_overscoped_sas, top_roles=[compute.admin, storage.admin, project.owner]

aya: Can we run an automated policy that restricts new SA creation to a small allowlist and require an approval ticket? I can push an org policy and gate via prow.

tony: Agreed. Short plan: 1) create deny policy for project.owner & wildcard admin roles for non-platform projects 2) rotate tokens for SAs used by CI that are overscoped 3) schedule remediation windows and notify teams.

sara: Which SAs are critical? I can produce a CSV with owners and usage metrics. Will post in shared drive.

max: Sara please tag SAs with `sec:review` and include last-used, last-key-rotation, and owner. We'll prioritize by last-used > 30d.

iam-bot: tagging complete: 120 tagged sec:review. export_url=https://vault.internal/redwood/iam/exports/iam-2026-03-22.csv

tony: Runbook snippet for token rotation (for CI SAs):
```
# rotate key for service-account
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-key.json --iam-account=sa-name@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# update secret in secret manager
gcloud secrets versions add sa-ci-key --data-file=new-key.json
# revoke old key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete OLD_KEY_ID --iam-account=sa-name@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

aya: I'll open a short-lived maintenance window and create PR for org policy: block-high-roles.yaml -> requires approval by infra-security.

deploy-bot: policy PR created: https://github.com/redwood-infra/policy/pull/521 (depends on infra-security review)

cs: Heads-up: notify platform teams and CS if any customer-facing pipelines are impacted by token rotation. We'll prepare customer-facing FAQ in case scheduled jobs fail.

max: No direct customer impact expected; still communicate proactively. Sara tag owners and send initial notice template.

legal-bot: Reminder: if any rotation affects PII-handling integrations, loop in legal for regulatory notice evaluation.

tony: I've started auto-remediation for low-usage SAs: downgrade role compute.admin -> compute.viewer for SAs with last_used < 30d and owner confirmed. Script run begins now.

iam-bot: remediation run started by tony at 1757653000: target=low_usage_keepers, count=74

aya: For the remaining high-usage SAs, scheduling manual review. Will request owners to submit justification and expected TTL for elevated roles. 48h to respond before we schedule a forced downgrade.

max: Also: immediate hardening: remove console-access from SAs and enforce short-lived access tokens for human-created keys. Add CI to fail builds with static SA keys.

tony: Added CI check: `no-static-sa-keys` in repo settings. Failing builds will block merges for any PR that adds plaintext SA keys.

cs: Drafted customer/partner note for infra teams; posting to #customer-success for review.

iam-bot: remediation progress: 74 downgraded -> 46 remaining high-usage SAs under manual review.

max: Action items recap:
- Tag & export SAs (sara) (done)
- Auto-downgrade low-usage SAs (tony) (in progress)
- Rotate keys for CI service accounts (owners/teams)
- Org policy PR to block new overscoped roles (aya) (PR open)
- CI gate to prevent static keys (tony) (merged)
- Customer/CS comms (cs)

legal-bot: Legal review queued for any customer-impacting rotations.

aya: Requesting infra-security review on PR 521. Please prioritize.

max: Timeline: aim to finish automated remediation in 6h; manual reviews complete in 48h. SEC ticket: SEC-499 opened. Owner=@max.

cs: I'll monitor support queue for automation failures. Ping me if any alerts.

tony: Remediation run complete: 74 -> downgraded to viewer. Script log: https://ops.internal/redwood/logs/iam-remediate-1757653200

max: Good job. Keep this thread for updates and post final closure when SEC-499 is resolved.
